annotations.title: Coast Map Pass: what it adds and how to get it

description: What the Coast Map Pass adds over the free map (offline regions for trips with no signal; longer tide and current ranges for assistants), its prices (CA$5 a month or CA$55 a year), whether it is on sale yet, and the purchase or support links. Covers offline use, longer tide ranges and upgrading.
